question: Point out which type of disorder best fits the following clinical description: insidious but progressive development of extravagant behavior, with an inability to meet the demands of social life and a decrease in overall performance. There is no evidence of hallucinations or delusions. "Negative" traits appear without having been preceded by clearly manifest psychotic symptoms.
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Insidious development" -> "progressive extravagant behavior" -> "inability to meet social demands" -> "decrease in performance" -> "no hallucinations or delusions" -> "negative traits without prior psychotic symptoms" -> "Simple schizophrenia" -> 85%

analysis: The clinical description provided suggests a disorder characterized by progressive development of extravagant behavior, social dysfunction, and negative symptoms without preceding psychotic symptoms. Simple schizophrenia is known for its insidious onset and predominance of negative symptoms without the presence of hallucinations or delusions, aligning well with the description.
